title: lotodes erianthum
intro: Lotodes erianthum, commonly known as "Gulancha" or "Tulsi ke Phool", is a flowering plant native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotodes erianthum include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system, making it a popular remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
